plugin.name: Dexter Ops
plugin.description: See and restrict what the Dexter Ops Telegram bot may do, and acknowledge its alerts.

manage.title: Manage the Dexter Ops bot
manage.description: See the bot, turn its operations off or on, mute notifications, acknowledge alerts and request operations.

botUrl.label: Bot address
botUrl.description: Origin of the bot's local API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8787. Only this host may be reached, even if it is a private address.

token.label: API token
token.description: The bearer token from the bot's api.token_file. It is stored encrypted.

setup.title: Set the bot address and token
setup.hint: Open Plugins → Dexter Ops → Settings, then fill in the bot address and the API token. The bot's [api] section must be enabled.
setup.retry: Check that the bot is running and that the address and token in the plugin settings are right.

status.title: Bot
status.incompatible: This bot (v{{version}}, API {{api}}) is not compatible with this plugin. Update the bot to v0.6.1 or newer, or the plugin.

mute.label: Mute notifications
mute.description: Stop the bot from sending alerts to Telegram for a while. Alerts are still recorded and are sent when the mute ends.

ops.title: Operations
ops.confirmPrompt: The bot will send a preview to Telegram. Confirm it in Telegram to run it.

policy.title: What the bot may do
policy.hint: Read-only. This comes from the bot's configuration file; the plugin can only turn things off.

toast.awaiting: Preview sent to Telegram. Confirm it there.
toast.started: Operation started. The result arrives in Telegram.

errors.BOT_REJECTED_TOKEN: The bot rejected the API token
errors.BOT_BAD_RESPONSE: The bot sent an unexpected answer
errors.INVALID_BOT_URL: The bot address is not valid
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests for that operation. Wait a few seconds.
